Recall and connections

Times tables in Year 3

Focus on 3, 4 and 8, retaining earlier 2, 5 and 10 facts. Connect direct recall to missing factors, inverse division and written calculations.

Times-table guide

Beyond a number answer

A grown-up records practical and reasoning work alongside digital practice.

  • Measure with real tools
  • Draw shapes and make a model
  • Read and record a real clock
  • Present collected data
  • Explain and check a method

How Year 3 promotion works

XP rewards effort and independent answers, but does not award a completed year. The academy checks broad independent coverage and later-day recall across this year’s families. Practical observations are recorded by a grown-up. A 12-shot promotion match then requires at least 90% independent accuracy, with the other goals still satisfied. Earlier facts remain available for review after promotion.

This is an in-game progression policy. It is not a DfE-approved pass mark, a diagnostic judgement or a guarantee that a skill will never be forgotten.
